mapper.select: SELECT /*LGVATT20450.retrieveAttendanceList*/ tac.time_and_attendance_code as code, tac.time_and_attendance_name as name FROM tb_att_code_c tac WHERE tac.time_and_attendance_type_code = #{timeAttendTypeName} AND tac.lt_time_attend_plan_tg_flag = 'Y' /* 2018.04.03 Future Plan 입력 가능한 근태코드만 조회 되도록 함 */

SELECT /*LGVATT20450.retrieveAttendanceDetailList*/ lcc.common_code as code, lcc.common_code_desc as name, lcc.code_data2_value as code_value FROM lgcom_common_code_c lcc, tb_att_code_c tac WHERE 1 = 1 AND lcc.code_data1_value = #{detailCode} AND tac.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} -- Session Parameter로 셋팅 AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_CODE' AND lcc.code_data1_value = tac.time_and_attendance_code ORDER BY lcc.sort_order_no asc

SELECT /*LGVATT20450.retrieveAttendanceDetailMessage*/ lcc.code_data2_value as message, lcc.code_data3_value as daylimit FROM lgcom_common_code_c lcc, tb_att_code_c tac WHERE 1 = 1 AND lcc.common_code = #{commonCode} AND tac.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} -- Session Parameter로 셋팅 AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_CODE' AND lcc.code_data1_value = tac.time_and_attendance_code

SELECT /*LGVATT20450.retrieveLowerEmpolyeeList*/
count(*) AS employee_size FROM tb_att_contract_n tan, emp_master em, lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE 1 = 1 AND tan.time_attend_contact_user_id = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND tan.organization_id = em.organization_id AND em.date_retire is null AND em.fse_yn = 'N' /* FSE 제외 */ AND em.flsa_yn = 'N' /* 단기파견자 제외 */ AND (em.date_retire IS NULL OR em.date_retire >= TRUNC(sysdate)) /* 재직자만 */ AND cc.code_type_code(+) = 'IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE' AND cc.common_code(+) = em.grade_title ORDER BY NVL(cc.sort_order_no, 10000), em.full_name_local

SELECT /*LGVATT20450.retrievePlanChk*/ COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_att_lt_time_attend_plan_n WHERE #{planStartDate} BETWEEN TO_CHAR(plan_start_date,'DD/MM/YYYY') AND TO_CHAR(plan_end_date,'DD/MM/YYYY') AND employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} /* 해외법인코드 */ AND progress_status_code in ('10', '20', '30')
SELECT /*LGVATT20450.retrieveWorkDay*/ lgvatt_common_pkg.get_work_days(#{subsidiaryCode}, TO_DATE(#{planStartDate}, 'DD-MM-YYYY') , TO_DATE(#{planEndDate}, 'DD-MM-YYYY')) as work_day from dual

SELECT /*LGVATT20450.retrieveTodate*/ TO_CHAR(lgvatt_common_pkg.get_working_date( #{subsidiaryCode} ,TO_DATE( #{planStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') ,#{workDay, jdbcType=NUMERIC} -- workday ,(select lgvhr_common_pkg.get_shift_type_code_func(#{subsidiaryCode}, #{employeeNo}, TO_DATE(#{planStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')) from dual) -- shift_type ), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS to_date FROM DUAL
SELECT /* LGVATT20450.retreivePlanningSeq */ sq_tb_att_lt_plan_id.nextval as planning_id FROM dual
mapper.update: UPDATE /* LGVATT20450.updateMutipleLongPlan */ tb_att_lt_time_attend_plan_n SET (request_code, progress_status_code) = (SELECT request_code, status_code FROM lgcom_approval_request_n WHERE request_master_id = #{approvalRequestId} AND request_code = #{requestCode}) /* 요청코드, 진행상태코드 */ , last_update_user_id = #{sessionAppUserId} /* 최종수정사용자아이디 */ , last_update_date = SYSDATE /* 최종수정일자 */ WHERE subsidiary_code = #{subsidiaryCode} /* 해외법인코드 */ AND employee_no = #{employeeNo} /* 사원번호 */ AND approval_request_id = #{approvalRequestId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} /* 승인요청아이디 */
mapper.select: {call /* LGVATT20450.insertApprovalRequest */ lgvatt_transaction_pkg.apply_att_lt_ta_plan_approval( #{retCode , mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} /*po_return_code*/, #{errorMessage, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} /*po_return_msg*/, #{sessionAppUserId} /*p_user_id.요청:요청자 application_user_id, 결재:결재자 application_user_id*/, #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} /*p_subsidiary_code 해외법인코드*/, #{planningId} /*p_planning_id*/, #{approvalCommand} /*p_approval_type. REQUEST:결재요청, APPROVAL:승인*/ ) }

SELECT /* LGVATT20450.retrieveRequestDocBaseInfo */ cc.code_data1_value AS arm_no , cc.parent_common_code AS request_code /* LGCOM 결재의 문서유형코드LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE와 매핑 */ FROM lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE' AND cc.common_code = 'ATT0002' /* 기능직 근태 수정요청 */
